summary: Complaints centre on stray dogs, LPG cylinder queues and black-marketing, potholes on the Naugawan Sadat road, a police beating video and a nagar panchayat too small for development, while appreciation is thin and limited to a CHC X-ray machine, a homeopathic clinic building and a sealed unlicensed clinic, with road repairs only approved so far.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (row 40: Naugawan Sadat, Amroha, None); AC extent from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naugawan_Sadat_Assembly_constituency (Amroha tehsil KCs Naugawan Sadat, Kailsa and Naugawan Sadat NP; Hasanpur tehsil KC with 15 PCs named on the page)

positives.english: CHC Naugawan Sadat got a digital X-ray machine, no more running to district HQ
positives.hindi: सीएचसी नौगांवा सादात में एक्स-रे मशीन लगी, अब जिला मुख्यालय नहीं दौड़ना पड़ेगा
positives.basis: Digital X-ray machines delivered to four CHCs (Rahra, Hasanpur, Dhabarsi, Naugawan Sadat) with technicians posted; article says patients will no longer need to run to the district headquarters for X-rays. Article is district-level but names the Naugawan Sadat CHC; private X-ray test costs Rs 300-400

positives.english: Homeopathic clinic in Naugawan Sadat now runs from its own building
positives.hindi: नौगांवा सादात में होम्योपैथिक क्लीनिक अब अपने भवन में चल रहा है
positives.basis: AC-specific (town): article lists Naugawan Sadat among towns where homeopathic clinics operate and states the building in Naugawan Sadat (and Sadarpur Bhud) is complete and the clinic now runs from its own building

positives.english: The illegal clinic with no doctor in Naugawan Sadat was sealed, and that is good
positives.hindi: नौगांवा सादात में बिना डॉक्टर वाला अवैध क्लीनिक सील हुआ, अच्छा हुआ
positives.basis: AC-specific (town, dateline Naugawan Sadat): inspection team sealed an unlicensed clinic where no qualified doctor was present, on the CMO's instruction; article dated 1 May 2026

positives.english: *Repair of three Naugawan Sadat area roads was approved, good news
positives.hindi: *नौगांवा सादात की तीन सड़कों की मरम्मत मंजूर हुई, अच्छी खबर है
positives.basis: Inference: approval only, no work start or completion reported. PWD approved repair of nine roads in Dhanaura, Naugawan Sadat and Hasanpur areas (about Rs 1.29 crore); three of the nine are in the Naugawan Sadat area; tendering has started. Treated as a weak positive pending field check

positives.english: *A sugarcane department road in Naugawan Sadat was approved, a good step
positives.hindi: *नौगांवा सादात में गन्ना विभाग की सड़क मंजूर हुई, अच्छा कदम है
positives.basis: Inference: approval only. Govt approved four sugarcane-department roads (about Rs 1 crore together); one is in the Naugawan Sadat area, to be built by PWD; article says tendering is only starting and construction has not begun. Treated as a weak positive pending field check

negatives.english: Hours in gas queues and no cylinder, with allegations of black-marketing
negatives.hindi: गैस के लिए घंटों लाइन, सिलिंडर नहीं मिलता, कालाबाज़ारी का आरोप
negatives.basis: AC-specific (town of Naugawan Sadat): people queued for gas in Naugawan Sadat, Hasanpur, Mandi Dhanora and Joya; consumers say cylinders sold black at Rs 1200-1500 and agencies overcharge (allegations as reported); no official response in the article

negatives.english: In Naugawan Sadat, stray dogs bit eight people within a few hours
negatives.hindi: नौगांवा सादात में आवारा कुत्तों ने कुछ घंटों में आठ लोगों को काटा
negatives.basis: AC-specific (town): on Monday 11 May 2026 stray dogs bit eight people within a few hours, worst in Mohalla Papad Talab; 28 people (new and old cases) got anti-rabies injections at the CHC; residents demanded the dogs be moved and a permanent solution; no official statement in the article

negatives.english: Nagar panchayat is too small, little room left for development work
negatives.hindi: नगर पंचायत का दायरा छोटा है, विकास के लिए जगह कम बची है
negatives.basis: AC-specific (Naugawan Sadat nagar panchayat, listed in the AC extent): MLA Samarpal Singh wrote to government that there is no room left for development work in the nagar panchayat and asked to add Khedi, Badshahpur and Bilna; ADM asked the SDM for a report within a week (2024 report, issue not shown resolved)

negatives.english: A video of a complainant being beaten at the police station went viral, it is alleged
negatives.hindi: थाने में फरियादी की पिटाई का वीडियो वायरल, आरोप है
negatives.basis: Naugawan Sadat police station (named after the town; article does not state its exact location, so AC membership rests on the town name): three videos of the head clerk slapping and beating a complainant went viral; SP sent him to police lines and ordered an inquiry; allegation as reported

negatives.english: Deep potholes on the Naugawan Sadat road, bikes slip, riders get hurt, and jams form
negatives.hindi: नौगांवा सादात रोड पर गहरे गड्ढे, बाइक फिसलकर लोग घायल, जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: AC membership of this road unconfirmed, so not counted in ac_specific_negatives: article names the Naugawan Sadat road with Azad Road (Amroha city) and Bijnor road; two-wheeler riders slip and get hurt, jams form; people allege repairs not done despite complaints

notes: AC confirmed as No. 40 Naugawan Sadat, Amroha district, reserved None (Wikipedia list). Wikipedia AC page lists KCs Naugawan Sadat, Kailsa and Naugawan Sadat NP (Amroha tehsil) plus 15 PCs under Hasanpur KC; Nagla, Budhanpur, Joya, Mandi Dhanora and Hasanpur town are not on that page, so they are not counted as AC-specific. Current MLA is inconsistent across sources; verify on the UP assembly site. Positives 4 and 5 are inferences from approvals only (no start reported) and are weak; only three positives are sourced delivered or completed benefits; a field check is needed to find better ones. Police station (negative 4) is counted as AC-specific on the strength of the town name only; the article does not give its location. Negative 5 (potholes on the Naugawan Sadat road) is not counted because the road's AC membership is unconfirmed. Oct 2026 leopard carcass in a Naugawan Sadat town mango orchard was seen in search results but not used (not fetched). No local news found on sugarcane dues, water supply or electricity in the AC. Simbhaoli and Dhanaura items are not in this AC. Field check recommended on dog bites, LPG supply, the homeopathic clinic, and whether the nine-road repairs have started. P4 weak positive: approval only, no work start reported. P5 weak positive: approval only, no work start reported.

round2.changes: Removed Ganga Expressway Hasanpur stretch (Hasanpur AC 41, not shown inside AC 40) and the district-level CM 43-project item; removed Hasanpur industrial park (NewsX/CM event, not AC 40); removed leopard item (Nagla/Budhanpur not in AC extent). Added homeopathic clinic in Naugawan Sadat (Amar Ujala 15 Apr 2026, verified) and sealed illegal clinic (Amar Ujala 1 May 2026, verified) as positives; added Naugawan Sadat road potholes (Amar Ujala 2 Oct 2026) as negative 5 (not counted, road membership unconfirmed). Positive 4 corrected to three Naugawan Sadat roads of the nine; positive 5 now a sugarcane-department road approval (inference). X-ray item basis corrected (Rs 300-400 is the private test cost, not a saving; article names the Naugawan Sadat CHC). Dog-bite English corrected to 'in a few hours'. Summary updated.
